description: Today's AI token prices by company: each company's price index in USD per 1M tokens at the mix of tokens agents send (87% cache read, 12% input, 1% output), weighted by its models' usage, with 1-day, 1-week and 1-month changes. Give one company to also get its models' usage shares and posted input, cached input and output prices, and its estimated spend on OpenRouter. For one model's prices use get_model_prices; for past values get_price_history. For questions like "what does Claude cost per 1M tokens?" or "which AI company's API is cheapest?".

company.description: One company; omit for all listed companies.

name: get_token_prices

age_hours.description: Hours from updated to this answer: the token prices are calculated once a day, for each UTC day, shortly after it ends

bloomberg_tickers.description: As the site shows them beside the lab: Bloomberg tickers of benchmark indices for the same lab. Prices on this site are calculated independently and differ from those indices.

change_1d_pct.description: Percent change from the latest value 1 to 4 days earlier (none: interpolated)

change_1m_pct.description: Percent change from the latest value 30 to 37 days earlier (none: interpolated)

change_1w_pct.description: Percent change from the latest value 7 to 10 days earlier (none: interpolated)

errata.description: Errors found in its final values: for one GPU or company, the last year's, as its page notes them under its value; in the list, those in the values its row gives (its latest, and the bases of its changes, which are changes of the values as published). As the page notes them under its value and the status page lists them: each a run of index days. A final value is never changed; the correct one is given when it can be recomputed, and the error is fixed from the next day

correct.description: The correct index value (none when it cannot be recomputed)

published.description: The index value as published those days (none when it differs from day to day)

reason.description: Why it was wrong, as the status page says

models.description: Its models in the index: those in OpenRouter's daily top 50, as its page lists them

price.description: The model's price at the mix, USD per 1M tokens

usage_share.description: Share of the company's tokens among its models in OpenRouter's daily top 50 (0 to 1): the index's weight

price.description: Latest index value, USD per 1M tokens at the mix (87% cache read, 12% input, 1% output)

fields.description: One company's: what its models and their figures are

not_listed.description: The list's: the index's companies not listed today, as on no list of the site (each needs a price, a month of history and a value for each change)

updated.description: When the token prices were last calculated (ISO 8601, UTC)

title: AI token prices
